hostNotes: Open prompt: anything genuinely visible from a car on the B100 between Torquay and Allansford counts, including signed turnoffs (Bells, Erskine Falls, Cape Otway) and things seen at a stop (Twelve Apostles, Gibson Steps). Merge spelling variants and plurals; vague scenery ('the view', 'nature', 'the coast') lands on Headlands and may be nudged toward something specific. Traps: 'the arch' usually means the Memorial Arch at Eastern View, not The Arch near Port Campbell; 'lighthouse' defaults to Split Point (Aireys), Cape Otway is separate; wind turbines are NOT on the GOR (nearest are past Warrnambool at Codrington) so reject; Geelong, the Otway Fly and Erskine Falls themselves are not visible, only their signs. Fire answers (burnt trees, rebuilt houses) are correct deep cuts, very local to Wye/Sep 2015. Dead animals count. A unique answer that is a real place or thing on the road is correct even if it is not in the bank.
